name: orbita-workspace
description: Gerenciador independente de contas e perfis de navegador

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && vite build
scripts.build:electron: tsup electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --platform node --format cjs --target node20 --out-dir dist-electron --external electron --external sql.js
scripts.ci: npm run test && npm run build
